para.preformatted:
Ver Who Date Changes
4.00a hvm 05/24/11 Created based on the xusb_storage.c example. 4.01a bss 11/01/11 Modified UsbIfIntrHandler function to unconditionally reset when USB reset is asserted (CR 627574). 4.02a bss 04/05/12 Modified the sequence of Cache Flush and Invalidation. The cache flush happens just before the driver API EPDataSend is called. Similarly the cache invalidation is done after the call to EPDataReceive and after the dma transfer is over. 5.6 pm 07/05/23 Removed powerpc support. 5.6 pm 07/05/23 Added support for system device-tree flow. 5.7 sm 09/23/26 Added Xil_AssertVoid checks to fix GCC warnings (CR-1276275). 5.7 sm 10/01/26 Reject out-of-range SCSI READ/WRITE through xusb_msc.c. Clear the CSW status and residue for each command.
